text: レッドは　みずのポケモン　ゼニガメに　きめるのじゃな？

patterns.name: 〜に　きめる
patterns.span: ゼニガメに　きめる
patterns.explanation: に before きめる names what you decide on. ゼニガメにきめる = 'decide on Squirtle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ asks for or gives an explanation; じゃ is old-man だ and な seeks agreement. きめるのじゃな = 'You're deciding, right?'
